toegepas.voor: Hulle was vroeg en die klok
toegepas.na: Hulle was vroeg, en die klok
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Hulle was vroeg' and 'die klok het ... gelui' are full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.na: Juffrou Mans Thandi se naam netjies
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'haar' straight after 'Juffrou Mans' can be read as the teacher's own name; naming Thandi removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'haar naam' straight after 'Juffrou Mans' can point to the teacher (or the mother) rather than Thandi.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Thandi removes a real pronoun ambiguity without changing who does what.

toegepas.voor: Sy naam was Sipho en hy
toegepas.na: Sy naam was Sipho, en hy
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Sy naam was Sipho' and 'hy het ... gaan sit' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: werk Thandi se ma laat en Thandi
toegepas.na: werk Thandi se ma laat, en Thandi
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'werk Thandi se ma laat' and 'Thandi stap dan' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Sipho se ouma het hulle daarna tot by Tant Rosa se hek gestap.
toegepas.na: Sipho se ouma het daarna saam met hulle tot by Tant Rosa se hek gestap.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Transitive 'iemand stap' copies English 'walked them'; Afrikaans says 'saam met hulle gestap'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'saam met hulle ... gestap' is the Afrikaans construction and keeps the same people, action and destination.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Applause is 'hande klap'; 'geklap' alone can mean slapped or banged.
toegepas.fout: 'hard geklap' alone can mean slapped or banged.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hande geklap' is the fixed expression for applause and changes nothing else.

laat_vaar.voor: en syne het spinasie en wortels in.
laat_vaar.na: en in sy klas s'n groei spinasie en wortels.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'syne het ... in' is loose and colloquial, and 'syne' reads as Sipho's own bed rather than his class's.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'syne het spinasie en wortels in' is natural spoken Afrikaans in a story, the proposal 'sy klas s'n' is clumsier, and it breaks the link with 'sy bedding' later in the story.

laat_vaar.na: nie een keer in die rede geval nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The idiom is 'in die rede val'; 'ingeval' on its own reads as the conjunction 'in case'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'inval' is a standard verb for interrupting a speaker, and the proposed 'in die rede geval' lacks the object it needs ('haar'), so it is not an improvement.

laat_vaar.voor: of Thandi ná skool sy bedding kom kyk
laat_vaar.na: of Thandi ná skool sy bedding wil kom kyk
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Reported invitation needs 'wil' to read naturally as a question about her wish.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'gevra of Thandi ... kom kyk' is natural reported speech, and adding 'wil' shifts the question from an invitation to her wish without fixing a fault.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Reading names out to a class is 'voorlees'; 'gelees' suggests she read them to herself.
na_skrywer.fout: 'die name ... gelees' does not clearly say the names were read out aloud.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but with 'voorgelees' the phrase 'vir die skool se koor' now reads as reading to the choir rather than the names for the choir, so it needs another fix (for example 'afgelees').
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: in die pouse vir almal by die trap van die koor vertel
na_skrywer.na: in die pouse by die trap vir almal van die koor vertel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written 'die trap van die koor' reads as the choir's steps; moving the place phrase forward fixes the attachment.
na_skrywer.fout: 'by die trap van die koor' can be read as 'the choir's steps'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but the proposed order creates 'vir almal van die koor', which can read as 'everyone in the choir' and changes who was told, so the writer must fix it another way.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: AWS writes a title before a name in lower case ('juffrou Mans', 'tant Rosa'); it recurs ten times, so I did not propose each change separately. A person should decide whether house style keeps the capitals.
